description: This source file defines the CalculatorViewModel class for a calculator application's frontend, handling user interactions, calculator logic, and UI state management.

classes.name: CalculatorViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class managing calculator operations, UI state, and user interactions for a calculator app.

methods.name: handleTap
methods.description: Handles user tap events on calculator buttons.

methods.name: inputDigit
methods.description: Processes digit input from the user.

methods.name: handleAction
methods.description: Processes non-digit actions like clear, decimal, percent, sign, backspace.

methods.name: inputDecimalPoint
methods.description: Inserts a decimal point into current input if not already present.

methods.name: backspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from current input.

methods.name: toggleSign
methods.description: Toggles the sign of the current input.

methods.name: applyPercent
methods.description: Converts current input to a percentage.

methods.name: setOperation
methods.description: Sets the current pending operation with the selected operator.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Performs a calculation based on provided operands and operator.

methods.name: syncDisplay
methods.description: Updates the display texts based on current state.

methods.name: decimal
methods.description: Converts a string to a Decimal object.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a Decimal number as a string for display.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message to the user.
